test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: What is the name of the project launched by the Uttar Pradesh to to provide broadband connectivity to 20 lakh rural households?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project GANGA.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Uttar Pradesh government has launched Project GANGA to provide broadband connectivity to 20 lakh rural households over the next 2-3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Full Form:** GANGA stands for **Govt Assisted Network for Growth and Advancement**.
 
• **Partnership:** An MoU was signed between the **State Transformation Commission** and **One OTT Entertainment Ltd (Hinduja Group)**.
 
• **Employment:** The project is estimated to create direct and indirect employment for over **1 lakh people**.
 
• **Target Areas:** Special priority is given to border districts such as **Shravasti, Bahraich, and Balrampur**.
 
• **Impact:** It aims to boost **telemedicine, online education**, and digital skilling in rural UP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• State Transformation Commission (STC)__

 __
 
• Formerly the State Planning Commission, it was renamed and restructured to act as a think-tank for the UP government, similar to NITI Aayog at the center.
 
 
 
• Broadband and GDP__
 
 
• Global studies suggest that a 10% increase in broadband penetration can lead to a significant boost in a region's GDP due to improved efficiency and new digital markets.
